clue.text: Laughing at a depressed fence

definitions.meaning: laughter written out as a pair of syllables, the sound of someone chuckling
a sunken boundary wall set in a ditch so it does not spoil the view from a country house

explanation.definitionFit: The same letters spell both the laughter noise and the name of a ditch-set garden boundary.

clue.text: An old ship with an incomplete load

indicators.note: something incomplete lacks a part, so the word for a load loses its opening letter

parts.note: a load carried by a ship is its cargo

explanation.surface: A vessel of yesteryear sailing with only part of its freight.
explanation.definitionFit: The vessel of Jason and his Argonauts in Greek myth.

clue.text: A sound item of jewellery

definitions.meaning: a bell's peal or a telephone's call
a band worn on the finger

explanation.definitionFit: One word covers both a bell's chime and a finger band.

clue.text: Approves of publicity about a boggy area

indicators.note: the publicity word goes about, that is around, the boggy area

parts.note: ads, short for advertisements, are publicity
a mire is a stretch of swampy ground

explanation.surface: Someone backs an advertising campaign for a marsh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the container signal here, not a link meaning 'concerning'.
explanation.definitionFit: To admire something is to regard it with approval and esteem.

clue.text: The top man's there, mad as can be

indicators.note: the letters are as mixed up as they can possibly be, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: The boss is over there, completely crazy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mad' looks like the anagram signal but is part of the fodder; 'can be' rearranges THERE MAD AS.
explanation.definitionFit: The head teacher is the senior figure in a school.

clue.text: Just thinking about going blonde?

definitions.meaning: fair and impartial
having a mind set on light-coloured hair, read whimsically

explanation.definitionFit: An impartial person is unbiased; read literally, it is someone with pale hair on the brain.

clue.text: Making a profound improvement

parts.note: read as making something more profound, in the sense of greater depth, rather than as a big betterment

explanation.definitionFit: Increasing in depth or intensity is to make more profound.

clue.text: Hold back, but take a cautious look

indicators.note: back tells us the word for hold is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: to keep something is to hold on to it

explanation.surface: Restrain yourself, yet sneak a careful glance.
explanation.definitionFit: A quick furtive glance is a peep or glimpse.

clue.text: The chief executive quietly staying in

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for playing quietly
a resident is someone staying in a place, such as a hotel guest

explanation.surface: The company boss keeps a low profile by remaining at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is only the join; RESIDENT itself means someone staying in a place.
explanation.definitionFit: A head of state such as the US one is the nation's top executive officer.

clue.text: Sale doing badly, close

indicators.note: doing badly suggests the letters of sale doing are knocked out of shape

explanation.surface: A shop's clearance event is underperforming, and it is nearly over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'doing badly' seems to be one phrase; 'doing' is fodder and 'badly' the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Beside or next to something is near it.

clue.text: Some juveniles want for nothing

indicators.note: some of the word juveniles is taken, a run tucked within it

explanation.surface: A few youngsters lack for nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A score of zero in sport is nil.

clue.text: Stops in extremities

definitions.meaning: finishes or concludes
the farthest points or tips of something

explanation.definitionFit: Finishing something and the far tips of it share one word.

clue.text: Step-fathers!

definitions.meaning: a ballet movement, from the French
dads, informally

explanation.definitionFit: The French word for a dance movement doubles as a plural of the childish name for dad.

clue.text: A little dog is put first-the last thing wanted

indicators.note: the dog verb is placed at the front, before the other piece

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow or tail them
a piece is a small portion

explanation.surface: Someone wants a small dog to be given priority, then finally changes their mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dog' is a verb meaning follow, not a pet.
explanation.definitionFit: A decoration or section added at the end of a book or piece is its closing part.

clue.text: Passing trains on it may be diverted

indicators.note: diverted trains go off their usual route, so the letters are rerouted into a new order

explanation.surface: Trains going through could be sent along a different line.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving from one state to another is a change or passage.

clue.text: Not in good shape-so tense

definitions.meaning: flawed or faulty
a past verb form for ongoing action, in grammar

explanation.definitionFit: A faulty object is flawed, and a grammatical tense for continuing past action has the same name.

clue.text: Longs to include article favouring protective wear

indicators.note: the longing word takes the other pieces inside it

parts.note: to pine is to long or yearn
a is the indefinite article
for means in favour of

explanation.surface: Someone yearns to add an item that supports protective clothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Longs' is a verb meaning yearns, not trousers or lengths; 'to include' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleeveless aprons or dresses worn over clothes to keep them clean.

clue.text: The Russian's single means of moving goods

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a van carries freight

explanation.surface: A Russian's one way of shifting merchandise.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is short for 'is', linking definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A typical Russian man's name, used as a nickname for any Russian.

clue.text: Grating as coppers being allowed into 3

indicators.note: the pieces are let inside the answer to clue 3

parts.note: refers to the answer of 3-down, a band of jewellery
p is penny or pence, copper coins

explanation.surface: Something abrasive happens as police are admitted to a jeweller's piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' are coins, not police: P, pence. The cross-reference 3 brings in RING from 3-down.
explanation.definitionFit: A harsh scraping noise is a grating sound.

clue.text: Turns aside, and this causes amusement

definitions.meaning: redirects or deflects
entertains or amuses

explanation.surface: Something swerves away and gives entertainment.
explanation.definitionFit: Deflecting from a course and entertaining someone both use this verb.

clue.text: How to cook small seafish

definitions.meaning: a method of cooking by submerging in hot fat
young fish of the ocean depths, read whimsically

explanation.definitionFit: Immersing food in hot oil, and whimsically the young fish of the ocean depths.

clue.text: An employer — sure to be

indicators.note: the word sure is yet to be in its final form, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone who hires staff is certain of themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who uses or employs something.

clue.text: A soldier without military personnel transport

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the soldier goes around the other piece

parts.note: a fighter is a combatant
RE is the Royal Engineers, a British army corps

explanation.surface: A soldier has no troops to move him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking; the Royal Engineers are a British army corps.
explanation.definitionFit: A cargo ship or aircraft carries goods.

clue.text: He survived the deluge, being a bit of a pig

definitions.meaning: a son of Noah, saved on the ark from the Flood
cured meat from a pig's thigh

explanation.definitionFit: One of Noah's sons shares a name with cured pork from the leg.

clue.text: A woman in a sort of loose robe

indicators.note: in signals letters sitting inside the following words

explanation.surface: A lady wearing a loose-fitting gown.
explanation.walkthrough: The name spans the words 'of loose'.
explanation.definitionFit: A short form of Florence, a female name.

clue.text: Possibly set about young beginner making complaint

indicators.note: the reworked set goes about, around, the starter letter
possibly suggests set could be arranged another way
a beginner is the first letter of the word young

explanation.surface: A novice may be about to make a fuss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' turns SET into STE, which goes 'about' Y, the start of 'young'.
explanation.definitionFit: An eyelid infection is a minor ailment, complaint meaning an illness.

clue.text: Get a salesman on edge and get a telling-off!

parts.note: rep is short for sales representative
a rim is a border or brim

explanation.surface: Persuade a nervy sales rep to accept a scolding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on edge' looks like nervousness, but 'on' simply sets the salesman before the edge.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebuke or scolding from an authority.

clue.text: A river goddess

definitions.meaning: the name of the Thames as it flows through Oxford
the Egyptian mother deity

explanation.definitionFit: Oxford's stretch of the Thames shares a name with the Egyptian deity.

clue.text: Each break can hurt

indicators.note: to break the word each is to smash it and put the letters back differently

explanation.surface: Every fracture may be painful.
explanation.definitionFit: To be sore or throb with pain.

clue.text: Reduced fare for politicians

definitions.meaning: a restricted food intake
a legislative assembly, as in Japan

explanation.definitionFit: Limited eating and a national assembly share the word.

clue.text: Behind with the letters?

definitions.meaning: after, as a Latin prefix
mail delivered to a home

explanation.definitionFit: A prefix meaning after, and the mail delivered daily.

clue.text: Order given when the ratings collapsed

indicators.note: the ratings fall apart and are reassembled in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A command shouted as the sailors fell down.
explanation.definitionFit: To put in order, tidy or set right.
